profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: I’m an Engineering Manager who helps companies build high-performing, scalable engineering teams and implement best practices, so they can deliver innovative and reliable web solutions that align with business goals.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Principal Software Engineer at Yesway, I architect, develop, and enhance enterprise grade software systems that support critical business operations across the organization. I partner with product and project stakeholders to define requirements, ensure proper system architecture, and break down complex technical goals into actionable development plans. I also leverage PDI Technologies to strengthen system design and industry specific workflows that drive operational excellence.

• Iterate with Product and project stakeholders on requirements.
• Work with Developers to break down goals into tasks.
• Ensure new development is properly architected.
• Take ownership of parts of the system.
• Coordinate complex implementations.
• Identify and apply abstractions as appropriate.
• Develop front-end systems (TypeScript, Bootstrap, jQuery, CSS).
• Develop back-end systems (C# .NET, MVC, SQL Server).
• Maintain and enhance current front ends and back-ends.
• Develop reports using SSRS.
• PDI Technologies

positions.title: Sr Drupal Back End/PHP Developer
positions.description:
As a Sr Drupal Back End/PHP Developer, I use PHP and MySQL/MariaDB to update and maintain Aroga (https://arogalife.com) and Boisset Collection (https://my.boissetcollection.com) websites. E-Commerce sites with custom member management software working closely with other developers.

• PHP, jQuery/JavaScript and MySQL/MariaDB
• Object-Oriented Programming, Design Patterns
• Drupal 7 for CMS 
• Pantheon Git version control
• MVC
• PHPUnit Test
• Agile / Jira
• Use SOAP / RESTful web services
• Integration with CyberSource and Authorize.net payment gateways
• Ensure secure code CAPTCHA & Bot Detection, SQL Injection, CSRF, and XSS

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
As a PHP Developer I use PHP and MySQL to update and maintain Pay My Warrant (www.paymywarrant.net) and DRN (www.digitalrecognition.net) websites. 

• PHP, jQuery/JavaScript and MySQL/MariaDB
• Object Oriented Programming
• BitBucket/GitHub/Git version control
• MVC
• Work with PHP custom framework
• Agile
• Use RESTful web services
• Use Fat Free Framework (F3)
• Stripe and Avalara Tax Integration

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
As a PHP Developer I use PHP, MySQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, and ElasticSearch to update and maintain VolunteerNow (www.volnow.org) and Voly (www.voly.org) websites. Founded in 1971, VolunteerNow is one of the largest and most active volunteer centers in the country, where we work to make volunteerism a part of everyday life.

• PHP, jQuery, MySQL, NoSQL, MongoDB and ElasticSearch
• Object Oriented Programming
• GitHub/Git version control
• MVC
• Work with PHP custom framework
• Agile
• Use RESTful web services
• Participate in all aspects of development (planning, architecture, development, testing, and deployment)

positions.title: Web Developer III
positions.description:
Lead the design, develop, implementation and maintenance of KCM websites within the guidelines outlined by the Web Software Developer Supervisor.

• PHP and JavaScript development
• Drupal site building ( develop, test, and configure modules & themes)
• Git version control
• Use Jira for project management
• Agile
• Proactive engagement in project challenges and problem solving
• Actively following the latest developments in PHP, CSS, xHTML, HTML5 and JS.
• SOAP web services
• Communicate regular updates, including progress made, work remaining to be done, and any hurdles encountered - on a regular basis to other members of the project team, as well any other clients (KCM departments) or consultants
• Database design and SQL query tuning
• Operate as Team Lead on large projects, providing direction and oversight to other team members as assigned by Web Software Developer Supervisor.
• Mentor as needed, providing assistance and technical knowledge to Developer 1 and Developer 2 team members.

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description:
As the Systems Analyst, I plan the functionality of websites using Drupal as the content management system, researched existing modules in the contributed modules to ensure the correct modules are utilized and use PHP, Drush, Git, MySQL, Ajax, and jQuery to create custom Drupal modules to get the desired functionality as required by the product owner.

•	Use Git and Subversion version control
•	Use Drupal Framework
•	Create and maintain ministry audio and video podcasts
•	Gather requirements for new projects and produce time-estimates and project plans
•	Apply Agile Scrum methodology
•	Utilize HTML, DHTML, CSS, PHP, Ajax, jQuery, Drupal 6.x, Drupal 7.x, Drush, MySQL Database and implementation of the SDLC (software development life cycle) to create http://gatewaypeople.com
•	Secured online forms with CAPTCHA, honeypot fields, SQL Injection, CSRF, and XSS

positions.title: Director, Web Development
positions.description:
As the Director of Web Technology, I oversee the overall quality, innovation, and creative vision of Gateway Church’s websites. Lead a group of web developers and designers in developing and executing unique and responsive website designs, e-mail marketing designs, and internal projects. 

•	Provide direction and leadership to team members
•	Gather requirements for new projects and produce time-estimates and project plans
•	Manage the functionality of all websites and integrate requirements into designs
•	Create an open communication environment between department and staff
•	Applied Agile Scrum methodology
•	Use Google Analytics to identify how websites are utilized

positions.title: Sr. Systems Analyst, Web Development
positions.description:
As the Sr. Systems Analyst, lead a group of web developers and designers in developing and executing unique and responsive websites, e-mail marketing designs, and internal projects. 

I planned the functionality websites using Drupal as the content management system. Created custom Drupal modules to get the desired functionality as required by the product owner. Interviewed product owner to help them clarify their goals for establishing a website. Applied knowledge of web programming techniques to create high quality websites.

•	Web Development team leader
•	Provided guidance and training to other team members
•	Created an open communication environment between department and staff
•	Created and maintained ministry audio and video podcasts
•	Gathered requirements for new projects and produce time-estimates and project plans
•	Applied Agile Scrum methodology
•	Utilized HTML, DHTML, CSS, PHP, Ajax, jQuery, XML, Drupal 6.x, Drupal 7.x, MySQL Database and implementation of the SDLC (software development life cycle) to create http://gatewaypeople.com as well as over 30 Gateway Church websites

positions.title: Systems Analyst, Web Development
positions.description:

Researched existing modules in the contributed modules to ensure the correct modules are utilized. Used PHP, MySQL, Ajax, and JQuery to create custom Drupal modules to get the desired functionality as required by the product owner. 

•	Employed use of Subversion version control
•	Created and maintained ministry audio and video podcasts
•	Communicated with ministries to maintain up-to-date information
•	Gathered requirements for new projects and produce time-estimates and project plans
•	Applied Agile Scrum methodology
•	Utilized HTML, DHTML, CSS, PHP, Ajax, jQuery, Drupal 6.x, MySQL Database and implementation of the SDLC (software development life cycle) to create http://gatewaypeople.com as well as 25 Gateway Church websites
•	Implemented Google Analytics for all of the Gateway Church websites, including tracking video playback (play, stop, pause, resume, full screen and full screen exit) and created custom reporting

positions.title: ITV/Smart Classroom Facilitator
positions.description:
As the ITV/Smart Classroom Facilitator, I managed our Interactive Television classrooms in collaboration within the Texas A&M system. I ensured that the Polycom videoconferencing equipment functioned properly and made regular updates to the equipment. I also managed the WTAMU smart classrooms providing regular maintenance using Crestron to control each room.

•	Created an open communication environment between department and staff
•	Maintained videoconferencing (Polycom) & Smart Classroom technologies
•	Designed and implemented Smart Classroom inventory database and Interactive Television (ITV) / Trans-Texas Videoconference Network (TTVN) websites
•	Created online tutorial system for Smart Classroom technologies

positions.title: WTOnline Programmer
positions.description:
As the WTOnline Programmer, I worked on the Distance Education website. Created custom online applications for WTAMU staff and students.

•	Maintained WTOnline 3.0 Distance Education website
•	Utilized HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and MySQL Database to program different applications for WTOnline 3.0
•	Maintained data and directory structures using Linux Server Administration techniques
•	Provided technical support for faculty, staff and students
